tokens.name: page
tokens.usage: The 60 %. Page background. Also the sheet field background. Dashboard: the page behind the sidebar and cards, and the field and track background inside a card.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: The 30 %. Raised shapes: header pill, Go to dashboard, pebbles, appeal sheet. Dashboard: sidebar, top bar, cards, dialogs, menus, the save bar and toasts.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: The 10 %, rust orange. Only for Invite bot, Appeal, the selected pebble ring, the selected feature name and Made in Rust. Text in accent reads on page. Dashboard: see the dashboard accent rule in the README.

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Label text on an accent fill: Invite bot and Appeal.

tokens.name: text
tokens.usage: Main text on page and surface: headline, button labels, pebble labels, strong footer links. Also the focus ring. Dashboard: main text, values, selected tab label.

tokens.name: text-secondary
tokens.usage: Supporting text on page and surface: lead, tagline, feature sentence, quiet footer links, logo placeholder. Also the field border on surface. Dashboard: help text, table headers, captions, and the border of every field (5.8:1 on surface).

tokens.name: scrim
tokens.usage: Flat layer behind the appeal sheet. Never add blur to it. Dashboard: behind dialogs and the phone sidebar.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Dashboard only. Quiet 1px lines: table rows, card dividers, chip and segment outlines. Decorative, never the only edge of a field.

tokens.name: ok
tokens.usage: Dashboard status: on, passed, saved. Toggle on. Text on page and surface (7.8:1 on surface); a fill takes on-status text.

tokens.name: bad
tokens.usage: Dashboard status: off, failed, danger, a field that needs a value. Toggle off. Text on page and surface (4.8:1 on surface); a fill takes on-status text.

tokens.name: warn
tokens.usage: Dashboard status: a warning or an exception. Yellow, so it never reads as the accent. Text on page and surface; a fill takes on-status text.

tokens.name: info
tokens.usage: Dashboard status: information and quiet text links (Back, Show more). Text on page and surface; a fill takes on-status text.

tokens.name: on-status
tokens.usage: Label text on an ok, bad, warn or info fill: chips, Go and Danger buttons, alerts.
